title: Sign-in and session events in the record: sign-ins and their failures, sign-outs, expiries, tokens, switches and roles
request: Phase 1's third remaining gap: a durable history of sign-ins (with failures and their reasons), sign-outs, session expiry, token create and revoke, workspace switches and role changes, as events under the visit, with a user-agent hash and a truncated address; adoptable by the main product.
spec: Eight kinds in the contract and two pure helpers; the accounts API writes them into the user's workspace's record; an expired session said once; never a token, a password or a raw address.
plan: Put the kinds and the helpers in dclab_core.
Write at every sign-in path, sign-out, token route, switch and role change.
Have the store say when a session expired, once.
Test under password auth on PostgreSQL.

decisions.decision: A failed sign-in has one reason code for a wrong e-mail and a wrong password.
decisions.why: The record must not say more than the answer the guesser got.

decisions.decision: A sign-in is written to the user's first workspace, a failure to the server's.
decisions.why: No request principal exists at sign-in; the audit does the same.

decisions.decision: The store that deletes an expired session says so, and identify writes the event.
decisions.why: A deleted row is seen once, so the event is written once.

change: dclab_core experience.py (kinds, hash_user_agent, truncate_ip), adapters, CHANGELOG 0.40.0; dclab_rnd accounts/api.py (_auth_event and its callers), accounts/store.py (the expiry signal), accounts/guard.py (identify); tests test_accounts (AuthEventsTests), test_core_experience; CORE_INTEGRATION.md, the plan.

findings.defect: The test client has no network address.
findings.scenario: The sign-in event carried no net field under the test client.
findings.cause: truncate_ip gives None for a name.
findings.fix: The test allows an absent address.

findings.defect: The test picked the wrong sign-in.
findings.scenario: The sign-out's session was compared with an earlier session's.
findings.cause: The record reads oldest first; the test took the first sign-in.
findings.fix: The newest sign-in by its time.

findings.defect: The published schema lacked the auth.* kinds.
findings.cause: make core-schemas not rerun after the kinds were added.

findings.defect: A sign-in into another workspace than the request's was written through a bare log and stamped with the request's workspace's consent.
findings.scenario: The default workspace has train on and W2 off; a user whose first workspace is W2 signs in: the event lands in W2 stamped train and leaves in W2's export.
findings.cause: A bare log has no folder; the stamp fell back to the current services.
findings.fix: The other workspace is opened whole from the pool when a request is at hand; a bare log or book is stamped operate unless it is the current workspace's.

findings.defect: Every wrong password wrote an event; nothing bounded an anonymous flood.
findings.scenario: A guesser fills the default workspace's event table.
findings.cause: Limits run for signed-in callers only.
findings.fix: One auth.sign_in_failed a minute per address and browser.

findings.defect: Parallel reads of one expired cookie each said the session expired.
findings.scenario: A page reload fires several requests; 59 of 60 rounds gave more than one event.
findings.cause: The signal was set whether or not the delete removed the row.
findings.fix: Set only when the delete's rowcount is one.
findings.test: test_sign_in_sessions_tokens_switches_and_roles_are_in_the_record (sequential; the parallel case follows from the rowcount)

findings.defect: truncate_ip kept a host group of an IPv6 address written with '::'.
findings.cause: Groups after the '::' were joined in.
findings.fix: Only the groups before '::' form the prefix, padded with zeros.

findings.defect: The identity-provider sign-in carried no session id; the password path read the session back for it.
findings.scenario: A sign-out could not be tied to an OIDC sign-in.
findings.fix: Both carry digest(token); the extra read is gone.

findings.defect: The auth test class inherited the fixture's eleven tests and ran them again; the secret check never looked at the raw cookie or token.
findings.scenario: Fifteen tests became twenty-six; a leaked token would have passed.
findings.fix: The test lives in the fixture's class; the cookie and the API token are asserted absent.

findings.defect: A bearer caller with a cookie wrote a sign-out as the token's user while the cookie's session was deleted.
findings.scenario: Two users' sessions crossed in the record.
findings.cause: The event did not check how the caller was identified.
findings.fix: Written only for a session caller.

outcome: Every sign-in and session change is in the workspace's record with its reason, without a secret. Reviewed: 8 findings fixed.
lessons: An expiry is seen only by the store that deletes it: let it say so once.
risks: The main product's auth and token rows are not in the field lists yet; the adapter lists the kinds until 23.12 refreshes them.
